title: Linear algebra is the language every AI speaks

scenes.title: Every AI speaks one language
scenes.say: Every AI you've ever talked to is doing *one* kind of math. Billions of times a second.
scenes.source: Illustration of a neural network, not a real model

scenes.title: The non-negotiable
scenes.say: Want to work in *AI?* This is the non-negotiable.

scenes.title: Words become vectors
scenes.say: A neural network turns words or pixels into lists of numbers. We call them *vectors.*
scenes.source: Example values, not from a real model

scenes.title: Matrices transform them
scenes.say: Then it multiplies them by grids of numbers called *matrices.* Row times column, add it up. Layer after layer.

scenes.title: Learning = nudging numbers
scenes.say: Learning just means *nudging* those numbers until the answers get less wrong.

scenes.title: One math, every frontier
scenes.say: The same math rotates *robot arms* and compresses genomic data.

scenes.title: Zenith Scale

visual.quote: “I'll skip the math and just prompt.”

scenes.say: I'll skip the math and just prompt? Zenith Scale: *four.* You'll hit a ceiling, student.
